blocks.tex: A strict local maximum of a cyclic word has both neighbours smaller. A strict local minimum has both neighbours larger. The retained order lemmas connect these notions to plateau extrema.

blocks.label: def:zz_local_max
blocks.title: strict local maximum
blocks.body:
For $w : \ZMod n \to \mathbb{R}$ and $i \in \ZMod n$, say $i$ is a \emph{strict local
  maximum} of $w$, written $\mathrm{IsStrictLocalMax}\,w\,i$, when
  $w_{i-1} < w_i$ and $w_{i+1} < w_i$.

lean.name: Gluck.Discrete.IsStrictLocalMax
lean.code:
def IsStrictLocalMax (w : ZMod n → ℝ) (i : ZMod n) : Prop :=
  w (i - 1) < w i ∧ w (i + 1) < w i
